description: After the release of the general election congressional debate schedule by the Utah Debate Commission, Peter Crosby, Democratic nominee for CD2, is concerned the October 20th debate with Blake Moore falls a full week after mail-in ballots have been sent out.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Peter Crosby for Congress
title: Late Scheduling of Congressional Debate Negatively Impacts Voter Choice, Sparks Concern from CD2 Candidate Peter Crosby — Press Releases — Peter Crosby for Congress
